title: Pa. Guard rescues two S.C. flood survivors
description: Members of the Pennsylvania National Guard and Pennsylvania Helicopter Aquatic Rescue Team perform a rescue and evacuation of two flood survivors on a UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter in Mullins, South Carolina, Sept. 20, 2018. The victims were flown to Florence Regional Airport where they were transferred to civilian paramedics.
